title: Taking seeds to a neighborhood swap

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I've got three envelopes of seeds for Saturday's swap. I won't get there until after lunch. Can someone take them for me in the morning?
turns.zh: 我有三個裝種子的信封要帶去星期六的交換會。我午餐後才會到，早上有人能幫我先帶去嗎？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I can take them. Are they labeled? We accept seeds even if you don't know the variety, but each envelope has to say the kind of plant and the month and year the seeds were collected.
turns.zh: 我可以幫你帶。有寫標籤嗎？不知道品種也能收，不過每個信封都要標明是哪種植物的種子，以及採收的年和月。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The beans and basil have both details. My neighbor gave me the pumpkin seeds. I know they're pumpkin seeds, but I didn't ask when she collected them.
turns.zh: 豆子和羅勒都有寫。南瓜種子是鄰居給我的。我知道是南瓜種子，但沒問她什麼時候採收的。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Give me the other two before I leave. Your neighbor should be back around noon, so you can ask her about the pumpkin seeds then. The swap goes on until three.
turns.zh: 我出門前先把另外兩包給我。你鄰居應該中午左右會回來，你到時可以問她南瓜種子的事。交換會會持續到三點。

audioScript:
I've got three envelopes of seeds for Saturday's swap. I won't get there until after lunch. Can someone take them for me in the morning?
I can take them. Are they labeled? We accept seeds even if you don't know the variety, but each envelope has to say the kind of plant and the month and year the seeds were collected.
The beans and basil have both details. My neighbor gave me the pumpkin seeds. I know they're pumpkin seeds, but I didn't ask when she collected them.
Give me the other two before I leave. Your neighbor should be back around noon, so you can ask her about the pumpkin seeds then. The swap goes on until three.
